name: @knowget/event-mesh
description: Event Mesh, Streaming & Messaging (P3-D02) — the governed spine every institutional fact travels along. P1-M05 gave the platform an event bus and a transactional outbox; those are mechanism, and this contract is the governance the mechanism was always missing: what event types exist and in what shape, which stream carries them, which physical backbone that stream is bound to, who consumes it under which delivery guarantee, where a consumer's position is, what failed, and on whose authority any of it is replayed. A published event type is immutable and a compatibility mode is enforced rather than documented, so a schema change cannot silently break a consumer. Nothing here holds a clock, an unseeded random source, a broker client or a payload it was not told it may retain: partitions are a hash of the declared key, retention bounds replay, and a stream that declares no payload retention cannot be replayed with one. Domain events carry ids, keys, versions, sequences, statuses, reason codes and counts only.
